640:t_1:169.en:
$$甲児$$
「Same as ever, it's red-hot over here too!」

640:t_1:170.en:
$$さやか$$
「We can't afford to lose to them either, $$甲児$$.」

640:t_1:171.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's how it is, everyone! The whole Volunteer Club is doing great!」

640:t_1:172.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We'll definitely come back, so wait for us!」

640:t_1:173.en:
$$宗介$$
「I promise! We'll all graduate together!」

640:t_1:176.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Still a bit stiff in the face, I'd say...」

640:t_1:177.en:
$$クラン$$
「Especially $$宗介$$! How many times do I have to tell you before you can manage a smile!」

640:t_1:178.en:
$$宗介$$
「I am not an actor. I cannot smile just because I am told to.」

640:t_1:179.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If I'd known it would turn into such a hassle, I should have forced myself to show my face at $$陣代高校$$...」

640:t_1:180.en:
$$宗介$$
「That may be true, $$千鳥$$... But this past month every one of us has been busy in our own way. We had no time for that.」

640:t_1:181.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Especially $n, who's been working with the Reactor group on Dr. $$トライア$$'s team's research the whole time.」

640:t_1:182.en:
$n
「That's why sending a video letter instead was a good idea, but I never thought we'd struggle this much...」

640:t_1:183.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$... This is such a hassle, so why don't you just put on a $$ボン太くん#robot$$ suit?」

640:t_1:184.en:
$$宗介$$
「What a pity... If I had brought it, Captain $$クラン$$, at least, would have been won over.」

640:t_1:185.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait, you... Where do you even keep that thing?」

640:t_1:186.en:
$$宗介$$
「In the locker in the Volunteer Club's clubroom.」

640:t_1:187.en:
$$宗介$$
「But I have no regrets. Surely whoever finds it will put it to use protecting the peace of the school.」

640:t_1:188.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't go planting the seeds of trouble in an everyday life that's finally calmed down!」

640:t_1:189.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wait, $$千鳥$$! We seek lasting peace through mutual understanding...」

640:t_1:190.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't think you and I will ever understand each other!」

640:t_1:191.en:
$$クラン$$
「OK! We got a good shot!」

640:t_1:193.en:
$$クラン$$
「Yes, yes! As I thought, you two are better when you're natural!」

640:t_1:194.en:
$$かなめ$$
「So what was all our hard work up to Take 27 for...?」

640:t_1:197.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$小野Ｄ$$! You haven't forgotten your promise to treat me to Galaxy Ramen, have you!」

640:t_1:198.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$風間$$! I got my hands on the first issue of 'Monthly Men's Super Robot' you wanted, so look forward to it!」

640:t_1:199.en:
$$さやか$$
「$$恭子$$, $$詩織$$! Are you working hard on your exam prep!?」

640:t_1:200.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll show my face at the graduation ceremony, too! Let's all go to karaoke again!」

640:t_1:202.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「But please spare me being treated like a handyman the second I show my face!」

640:t_1:203.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「We do activities other than picking up trash, you know.」

640:t_1:204.en:
$$竜馬$$
「$$大貫$$, sorry for letting you down. When I get back, hire me again!」

640:t_1:205.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Hello everyone, how are you? This is former student teacher $$西条涼音$$.」

640:t_1:206.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n and I are doing well, too! I... The two of us, $n and I, are looking forward to the day we can see you all!」

640:t_1:207.en:
$n
「H-hey, Miss $$スズネ$$! You're overdoing the appeal!」

640:t_1:208.en:
$$ボス$$
「Ha ha ha! Too bad, boys - me included!」

640:t_1:209.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「These two... seem to have become a couple before we knew it!」

640:t_1:213.en:
$n
「Wha! What are you saying, Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

640:t_1:214.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The cool, wild, brooding $n that everyone knows is dead!」

640:t_1:215.en:
$$宗介$$
「What's here now is a dimwit who can't even read the room but got himself a girlfriend!」

640:t_1:218.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「The power to love is infinite, after all.」

640:t_1:219.en:
$$甲児$$
「Same as ever, it's red-hot over here too!」

640:t_1:220.en:
$$さやか$$
「We can't afford to lose to them either, $$甲児$$.」

640:t_1:221.en:
$$アルト$$
「That's how it is, everyone! The whole Volunteer Club is doing great!」

640:t_1:222.en:
$$かなめ$$
「We'll definitely come back, so wait for us!」

640:t_1:223.en:
$$宗介$$
「I promise! We'll all graduate together!」

640:t_1:225.en:
$$アスカ$$
「If you're going to stand there gawking at them all wistfully, why don't you go and hang out with the Volunteer Club bunch?」

640:t_1:226.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I can't go back in there anymore...」

640:t_1:229.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm just a little... lonely, that's all.」

640:t_1:230.en:
$$カヲル$$
($$シンジ$$... I believe that someday the day will come when your feelings are rewarded...)

640:t_1:233.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Well... I can't see Big Sis anywhere...」

640:t_1:234.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Come to think of it, I haven't seen her today...」

640:t_1:235.en:
$$ノノ$$
「N-no way, Big Sis...! Did you get the departure day wrong and go off to play somewhere...!」

640:t_1:236.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ラルク$$ won't be coming.」

640:t_1:239.en:
$$カズミ$$
「$$ラルク$$ came to me for advice, and asked me to keep quiet about it.」

640:t_1:240.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Why, Big Sis $$カズミ$$! Has Big Sis $$ラルク$$ come to hate $$ノノ$$!?」

640:t_1:241.en:
$$カズミ$$
「That's not it, $$ノノ$$... But what $$ラルク$$ needs right now is time to think alone.」

640:t_1:242.en:
$$カズミ$$
「And $$ラルク$$ has made her decision. A path that puts her own power to use.」

640:t_1:244.en:
$$カズミ$$
「I haven't heard the details either... But she will be the linchpin of this fleet...」

640:t_1:246.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then Big Sis is coming with us too, right?」

640:t_1:247.en:
$$カズミ$$
「We just got word, but it seems her departure will be later than ours.」

640:t_1:248.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Even so, if we can meet again in the galaxy, $$ノノ$$ will go on ahead, make a road for Big Sis, and wait for her.」

kept_omissions: 640:t_1:188: who is 'sowing seeds' left as imperative at Sousuke (Kaname to Sousuke, scene settles it)

640:t_1:184/187: '懐柔' rendered 'won over'; 'that' (アレ) = the Bonta-kun prototype.
